newsitem.title: UK: BOC slips lower after recent good run.
newsitem.headline: BOC slips lower after recent good run.

text.p: Shares in BOC Group Plc were down 14-1/2p to 948-1/2 by 0915 GMT as investors took some profits after solid gains over the past few weeks, dealers and market makers said.
"We're just seeing a bit of profit-taking. The shares have been well bid and were bound to come off a bit," one market maker said.

Shares in the speciality chemicals group have jumped over 12 percent since January 10. Last month the company said it expected to continue making progress in its gases and distribution services business in 1997.
The company is due to report first-quarter results on February 20.
